name: numi-lab
description: Guide Codex through native research workflows across the Apple Silicon Numi Lab suite.

interface.longDescription: Use Codex to discover, operate, and improve Apple-native research workflows across NumiVivo, NumiTissue, NumiBrain and NumanX, Numi Human, Matter and NumiSolver, robotics, BirdFlow, and Numi Automata. Codex routes the task to its owning tool, checks live capabilities and existing artifacts, and reports measured outcomes with their evidence limits. The plugin supplies instructions; each runtime must be installed separately and accessible in the selected local environment.
capabilities: Discover installed Numi tools and workflows
Inspect embodied brain and Human mechanics
Evaluate robot policies and retained evidence
defaultPrompt: Check this Mac’s Numi Lab setup and show which native workflows are ready.
Use my prepared NumiVivo system for an MD run and inspect its evidence.
Evaluate my Numi robot policy on held-out rollouts and compare physical outcomes.
